request.query: SELECT mu.mukey, mu.muname, c.cokey, c.compname, c.comppct_r, c.majcompflag, c.hydgrp, h.hzname, h.hzdept_r, h.hzdepb_r, h.awc_r, h.wthirdbar_r, h.wfifteenbar_r, h.sandtotal_r, h.claytotal_r FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('point(-93.620000 42.030000)') AS k INNER JOIN mapunit mu ON mu.mukey = k.mukey INNER JOIN component c ON c.mukey = mu.mukey LEFT JOIN chorizon h ON h.cokey = c.cokey ORDER BY c.comppct_r DESC, c.cokey, h.hzdept_r
